source: Class defaults for a passenger-car cooling system (engine thermal plan T1, out/engine_thermal_plan.md, vault PHYS-063). Radiator [AS]: 0.35 m2 frontal area, ram coefficient 0.35 (face velocity = 0.35 x ram airspeed), UA 1500 W/K at 2.0 kg/s air, exponent 0.6 (the usual Re^0.6 air-side scaling, Incropera & DeWitt ch. 7 correlation form [C S12]); cross-flow both-unmixed eps-NTU (Incropera Table 11.3 [C]). Fan [AS]: 3.5 m/s face velocity, on at 98 C, off at 93 C (a 5 K band, the 81/75 C example of US 5992755 [C S11] shifted), 300 W reported only. Gauge [AS]: buffered like a dashboard needle, 0 at 40 C, 0.5 from 75 to 105 C, 1 at 125 C. Warnings [AS]: overheat 118 C, cold ('blue') below 50 C.
